title: Unit Event — Unreliable Notes — Episode1 A Warm Memory

meta.Event Outline: Kanade delves into the "warmth" Mafuyu feels from her music, hoping to identify its nature. When she learns it relates to a memory of Mafuyu's mother, she starts working on a new song, but finds something isn't right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Am I taking this song in the right direction...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope that it has some effect on Mafuyu's heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Even when it was still just a demo, I had a good feeling about this song.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me too!
It really hits home for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate you all saying that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still haven't been able to save Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's dad has come to terms with her feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which I think has helped put her mind at ease a little. However...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She still looks to be in pain from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have to compose a song that can save her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I've written a number of songs already, and every time, I feel like I'm missing something.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You often say that my songs feel “warm”...
What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are you trying to ask?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry, that came out of nowhere.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... You know how you often talk about how my songs feel “warm”, yes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: From what I understand, that warmth you feel means quite a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If I can learn more about where that comes from, then I think I can get closer to actually composing a song which can save you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see what you mean.
It's important to have a clear picture of what you want to create.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you know where that warmth comes from, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The warmth I feel from Kanade's songs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I was little, I caught a cold...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And my mom nursed me back to health.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's always busy with neighborhood association business...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But she stayed by my side the entire day that time.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She cut apple slices in the shape of rabbits for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I remember those being so delicious...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even held my hand as she sang me lullabies.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The sensation I feel whenever I listen to one of your songs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's similar to what I felt back then.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Kind of surprising to hear, though.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember what Mafuyu told us before? Listening to Kanade's songs feels like having apple slices, she said.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Putting two and two together, those were probably the same ones her mom made for her when she caught that cold, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
In that case...
I'll try composing a song based on that memory next.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mafuyu doesn't actually want to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I must've missed so many warning signs.
I feel absolutely terrible.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I still don't know what Mafuyu is going to work towards moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: As painful as this is going to be for you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I plan on giving her all the support I can so that she's able to choose her path in life freely.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (She never wanted to become a doctor...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (So, everything I've done... It was all a mistake?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (I made the right choices, for her happiness.)
